decision.observation: The closed gate has hardware on both posts: a metal bar on the left post (~0.25,0.34) and a lever + hook on the right post (~0.68,0.31 and ~0.70,0.44); a tap with a brown pot sits by the right post. The goose stands mid-path south of the gate.
decision.hypothesis: The left-post bar may be the latch (hinged right); grabbing it with the beak may unlatch and swing the gate open. It has not yet been beaked at close range.
decision.memory: Right-post latch grabs only sparkled. Bowl sits behind the gate's lower-left rails.
